_comments: The Forms API surface (issue #303). Each row becomes a typed base class in
a hand-written server subclass in forms-core-entities-server registers under the same key and supplies
GenerationType Manual, so CodeGen emits the typed contract only and never a body.
RequiredScope is an API-KEY CEILING, not the authorization. MJ checks it for API-key sessions only (an
interactive user, an in-process Execute() and a magic-link session all bypass it), so the one gate every
caller passes through is still each operation's Authorize(). Reads require forms:read, changes forms:write
(seeded in ../api-scopes/, allowed for MJAPI in ../api-application-scopes/). GetRespondentForm and
SaveResponse carry none: their Authorize() demands a magic-link session, which is never an API key.
The type files under types/ carry NO import lines: CodeGen pastes them verbatim into the generated
module, and de-duplicates declarations by NAME, keeping the first. Every exported name is therefore
Forms-prefixed and declared once; operations that share a contract share the file.

fields.Name: Publish Form
fields.Description: Publish a form's current authored structure as a new version, server-side and in one transaction: read the live rows, build the snapshot with the contracts builder, refuse it if any rule fails the strict parsers, retire the incumbent Published version, insert the new one and mark the form Published. Template forms are refused.

fields.Name: Clone Form
fields.Description: Copy a form's whole authored tree (pages, questions, options, screens, bindings, automations) into a new Draft form or a template in one transaction, rewriting every rule and field mapping that named a copied question or page. Nothing is left behind on failure. Also the save-as-template verb.

fields.Name: Create Form From Template
fields.Description: Create a new Draft form from a saved template or a starter gallery blueprint, in one transaction.

fields.Name: Archive Form
fields.Description: Archive a form: move it to Closed and close every Active share link in the same transaction, so the public path stops accepting responses.

fields.Name: Restore Form
fields.Description: Restore an archived form: back to Published when it has a Published version, else to Draft. Share links stay closed until reopened.

fields.Name: Issue Distribution Link
fields.Description: Create and open a share link for a form. Slug generation and its uniqueness retry, and the anonymous magic-link provisioning, all happen server-side.

fields.Name: Reissue Distribution Link
fields.Description: Give a share link a brand-new access credential while keeping its slug, so every shared URL keeps working and a leaked credential stops being redeemable.

fields.Name: Open Distribution
fields.Description: Open a share link to responses (Status Active and IsActive), provisioning a fresh access credential on the way.

fields.Name: Close Distribution
fields.Description: Close a share link to responses and revoke its access credential in the same save.

fields.Name: Get Distribution Claims
fields.Description: Report which of a form's share-link slugs other installed apps own, and which claimant apps could not be consulted. Read-only.

fields.Name: Save Automation
fields.Description: Create or update one on-submit step and the entity binding it runs, in one transaction with the built-in steps seeded on a form's first configured step and the form-settings mark that makes the form's own automations authoritative.

fields.Name: Reorder Automations
fields.Description: Rewrite the run order of every on-submit step of a form in one transaction. Sync steps always precede Async ones, so an order that contradicts that is refused.

fields.Name: Remove Automation
fields.Description: Remove one on-submit step. The binding it ran is kept, and the form stays marked as owning its automation list so removing the last step cannot restore the legacy built-ins.

fields.Name: Get Response Summary
fields.Description: Every section of the reporting dashboard for a form (headline counts and typical duration, who responded, per-question charts, written-answer insights, the page funnel), computed server-side from every answer. Returns counts, rates and groupings, never an email, phone, name or written answer (numeric min/max and grouping labels such as countries, organisations and email domains do come from answers; see the output type). Read-only.

fields.Name: List Responses
fields.Description: One page of a form's responses with the total row count, filterable by version and status; with IncludeAnswers, each row's stored answers and the labelling definition, which is how the export reads every response page by page. Read-only.

fields.Name: Get Response Detail
fields.Description: One response with everything its detail view shows: the response row, its stored answers, the provenance of the files they reference, the automation runs it triggered and the business records those wrote, plus the published definition that labels the answers. Sections the caller may not read are reported as unavailable rather than empty. Read-only.

fields.Name: Get Respondent Form
fields.Description: What an anonymous respondent loads to render a form: an allowlisted projection of the published definition (no answer key, ending screens, knockout conditions, automations or quota), the resume snapshot for a resumed draft, and the captcha flag. Authorized only for a magic-link session scoped to the slug's distribution. No RequiredScope: its Authorize() admits only a magic-link session scoped to the link, which is never an API key, so an API-key scope would gate nothing.

fields.Name: Save Response
fields.Description: Every respondent write, partial autosave and final submit alike. Validates and settles visibility with the contracts rules, enforces the quota atomically, writes the response and answers and, on a final submit, enqueues the on-submit automations in the same transaction. The server decides whether the form has ended and which ending screen shows. No RequiredScope: its Authorize() admits only a magic-link session scoped to the link, which is never an API key, so an API-key scope would gate nothing.

fields.Name: Delete Template
fields.Description: Permanently delete a saved template and everything under it (pages, questions, options, screens, automations, bindings) in one transaction. Only a template can be deleted, and only one with no responses, versions or share links; a working form is archived instead.
